name: gtm-skills
description: For B2B founders, CMOs, product marketers and sellers: decide which go-to-market motion should lead (product-led, sales-led, partner or community), which category to own, what your core message is, and whether a live deal is on track and what to do next. Give it your product, buyers, stage and market, or your own deal facts; get the four motions scored, a positioning and message hierarchy, vague AI prompts made specific, and, from the four Deal Execution skills, a deal health score, a close plan, discovery questions, a buying group map, concession costs and deal stage email sequences. Built on Helix's IMPACT, EPIC and CRAFT methods.
